options.content: GitHub and DevLake prove PR/check events. They do **not** prove an off-platform substantive review. #2866 is a merge-on-green control, not a review-time sample. Missing agent boundaries remain missing until a SHA-bound event is appended.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source_commit_sha AS `Source commit`, ledger_sha256 AS `Ledger SHA-256`, schema_sha256 AS `Schema SHA-256`, event_count AS `Events`, generation AS `Generation`, projected_at AS `Projected (UTC)` FROM waaseyaa_delivery_projection_state WHERE projection_id = 'delivery-agent-events/v1'

SELECT number AS `PR`, state AS `Status`, github_created_at AS `Submitted (UTC)`, merged_at AS `Merged (UTC)`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, github_created_at, COALESCE(merged_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP())) / 3600, 2) AS `Open hours`, LEFT(head_commit_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM _tool_github_pull_requests WHERE github_created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY number

panels.title: GitHub-native review evidence by exact head

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.number AS `PR`, SUM(CASE WHEN r.commit_sha = p.head_commit_sha THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Current-head reviews`, SUM(CASE WHEN r.github_id IS NOT NULL AND r.commit_sha <> p.head_commit_sha THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Superseded-head reviews`, MIN(CASE WHEN r.commit_sha = p.head_commit_sha THEN r.github_submit_at END) AS `First current-head review (UTC)`, LEFT(p.head_commit_sha, 12) AS `Current head` FROM _tool_github_pull_requests p LEFT JOIN _tool_github_pull_request_reviews r ON r.connection_id = p.connection_id AND r.pull_request_id = p.github_id WHERE p.github_created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY p.number, p.head_commit_sha ORDER BY p.number

SELECT display_title AS `Run`, status AS `Status`, conclusion AS `Result`, run_started_at AS `Started (UTC)`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, run_started_at, github_updated_at) / 60, 1) AS `Minutes`, LEFT(head_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM _tool_github_runs WHERE github_created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY github_created_at DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Time to first substantive review (agent-event authority)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.number AS `PR`, MIN(e.occurred_at_utc) AS `First substantive review (UTC)`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.github_created_at, MIN(e.occurred_at_utc)) / 60000000, 2) AS `Minutes from submission`, MIN(e.evidence_kind) AS `Evidence` FROM _tool_github_pull_requests p LEFT JOIN waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 e ON e.pull_request = p.number AND e.event_type = 'substantive_review_issued' AND e.occurred_at_utc IS NOT NULL WHERE p.github_created_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY p.number, p.github_created_at ORDER BY p.number

SELECT pull_request AS `PR`, event_type AS `Event`, occurred_at_utc AS `Occurred (UTC)`, recorded_at_utc AS `Recorded (UTC)`, actor_kind AS `Actor`, review_depth AS `Depth`, outcome AS `Outcome`, finding_count AS `Findings`, evidence_kind AS `Evidence`, LEFT(head_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 ORDER BY source_ordinal DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT f.pull_request AS `PR`, f.verifier_id AS `Verifier`, f.check_type AS `Check type`, f.claim_text AS `Claim`, f.observed_text AS `Observed`, COALESCE(a.adjudication_classification, 'pending') AS `Adjudication`, a.candidate_defect_confirmed AS `Candidate defect?`, f.safety_effect AS `Safety effect`, f.elapsed_ms AS `Cost ms`, LEFT(f.head_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 f LEFT JOIN waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 a ON a.causation_event_id = f.event_id AND a.event_type = 'verification_finding_adjudicated' WHERE f.event_type = 'verification_finding_issued' ORDER BY f.source_ordinal DESC LIMIT 50
